name: Caffeine PO Q4h PRN Funny Nurse Makeup Bag
seoTitle: Caffeine PO Q4h PRN Funny Nurse Makeup Bag
metaDescription: A funny nurse makeup bag that prescribes caffeine PO Q4h PRN. A useful, laugh out loud gift for a nursing grad, a coworker, or Nurses Week.
summary: A makeup bag that writes caffeine like a medication order, a funny and useful gift for any nurse who runs on coffee.
whyItWorks: Caffeine PO Q4h PRN is the kind of joke only someone in healthcare fully appreciates. It reads like a medication order, by mouth every four hours as needed, and it is a pretty accurate description of how many nurses get through a 12 hour shift. A new grad who just spent semesters learning abbreviations will grin at it.

The joke sits on something genuinely useful. A zip pouch holds the small things nurses carry daily, like lip balm, hand cream, hair ties, a phone charger, or a granola bar for the break that may or may not happen. It also doubles as a toiletry bag for travel nurses or a weekend away. It is budget friendly, so it is easy to give several for Nurses Week or bundle with a coffee gift card for a graduation present that ties the whole joke together.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for the bag's size and material, since the title does not list them.
A coffee gift card or a bag of beans pairs naturally with the caffeine joke.
The medical abbreviations land best with nurses and nursing students who know them.

faq.q: Is this a good nursing graduation gift?
faq.a: Yes, the medication order joke is especially fun for a new grad who just learned all those abbreviations.

faq.q: Will a non nurse get the joke?
faq.a: Probably not, but that is part of the charm for the nurse receiving it.
